newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals estimates S.Africa unemployment at 23-25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Stals estimates S.Africa unemployment at 23-25 pct.

text.p: Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals on Tuesday estimated South African unemployment at 23 to 25 percent of the economically active population.
Stals told reporters that South African unemployment statistics were unreliable and said the central bank had to plan largely on the basis of estimates.
"The approach we follow is to say that 45 percent of the economically active population of South Africa is not employed in the formal sector of the economy.
"That is not the total unemployment...how much of that 45 percent still makes a reasonable living in the informal sector?

"The best estimate that we can make as the Reserve Bank is that at least half of those people are not employed so we come to 23, 24, 25 percent - some people put it as high as 30 percent - who are unemployed.
"Whatever it is, it is high," Stals said.
